in_hebrew.name: Amsden
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Amsden הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘am’ (sovereign) and ‘sige’ (victory), Amsden means ‘powerful friend’ or ‘strong in battle’. This name was common among Anglo-Saxon warriors and kings.
